name: robots/akselov__digital-twin-opcua
title: KUKA KR 16-2 via KUKAVARPROXY (KUKAVARPROXY_communication.KUKA)
intro: KUKA KR 16-2 via KUKAVARPROXY (KUKAVARPROXY_communication.KUKA), adapted from akselov/digital-twin-opcua. It reads `joint_positions`, `motor_velocities`, `motor_torques` and `motor_currents`; runs `move_joints`. `move_joints`: write the six axis values to TARGET_AXIS as an E6AXIS string; the KRL program moves to it. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
